title: Milo Yiannopoulos, a Right-Wing Provocateur, Is Arrested by ICE
summary: Mr. Yiannopoulos, a prominent early supporter of President Trump, was detained at the New Orleans airport. The Trump administration publicized his arrest and shared a mug shot.
